translations.idiomatic: Provincial officials already had power to punish clerks; governors must be ordered to match men to posts, not trial men in unsuitable places.

sentences.zh: 舉賢劾不肖，再簡廉正大員，以時巡察，遇有貪官蠹吏，列狀奏聞。

translations.literal: Recommend the worthy and impeach the unworthy; again select upright and incorruptible officials to inspect on schedule; when corrupt officials and predatory clerks are encountered, list the facts in memorials to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Recommend the worthy and impeach the unworthy; appoint upright inspectors to tour on schedule and memorialize on every corrupt official or predatory clerk they find.

sentences.zh: 」 黃河北徙，山東郡邑屢被水。

translations.literal: " The Yellow River shifted northward, and prefectures and counties in Shandong were repeatedly afflicted by flood.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River had shifted north, and Shandong prefectures and counties suffered repeated flooding.

sentences.zh: 百川疏請賑恤，河督文彬、巡撫丁寶楨請仍挽复淮、徐故道，命廷臣集議。

translations.literal: Baichuan memorialized requesting relief; the river director Wenbin and Governor Ding Baozhen requested that the old course at Huai and Xu still be dredged and restored, and the court ordered ministers to assemble for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Baichuan memorialized for relief. River director Wenbin and Governor Ding Baozhen asked to restore the old Huai–Xu channel, and the court ordered a ministerial debate.

sentences.zh: 百川疏言：「黃水宜南宜北，必將折衷一是。

translations.literal: Baichuan memorialized, saying: "Yellow River water may suit going south or north; a single balanced decision must be reached.
translations.idiomatic: Baichuan wrote that the Yellow River might flow south or north, but the court must settle on one coherent policy.

sentences.zh: 如議挽復故道，論工程，論經費，引黃濟運，有未可遽定者三端：如即以大清河為黃水經流，舊道斷不能容，河面必須加寬，民間田廬如何移徙，如何安置，則度地宜審也；

translations.literal: If it is proposed to dredge and restore the old course, considering the works, considering the expenses, and drawing the Yellow River to aid the grain transport—there are three points that cannot hastily be settled: if the Daqing River is taken at once as the Yellow River's main channel, the old course certainly cannot contain it, the river surface must be widened—how are common people's fields and dwellings to be moved, how are they to be resettled? Then surveying the land ought to be examined carefully;
translations.idiomatic: If the old course were restored, three questions could not be rushed: using the Daqing River as the main channel would require widening the bed beyond what the old course could hold—how would farmland and homes be moved and resettled? Land surveys must come first;

sentences.zh: 且即河面加寬，仍恐萬難容納，別開支河，勢不容已，徒駭、馬頰、鉤盤、鬲津猶可指名，可否開行，有無貽害，則分水宜權也；

translations.literal: moreover, even if the river surface is widened, there is still fear it can hardly contain the flow; opening branch channels is a trend that cannot be stopped—Tuhai, Mabang, Goupan, and Gejin can still be named; whether they may be opened, whether there will be harm—then dividing the water ought to be weighed;
translations.idiomatic: even widened, the channel might not suffice, and branch streams such as Tuhai, Mabang, Goupan, and Gejin would likely be needed—each opening must be weighed for benefit and harm;

sentences.zh: 黃水北行，其事為創，萬一不善料理，人情騷動，物議沸騰，則相機宜慎也。

translations.literal: the Yellow River flowing north is an unprecedented matter; if by any chance it is not well managed, popular feeling will be agitated and public discussion will boil—then seizing the moment ought to be cautious.
translations.idiomatic: northward diversion would be unprecedented; mishandling it could stir public unrest and fierce debate—timing must be handled with care.

sentences.zh: 請特派大臣履行上下游詳勘，然後定策。

translations.literal: I beg that a specially dispatched high minister conduct detailed survey of the upper and lower reaches, and then fix the policy."
translations.idiomatic: He asked that a senior minister survey the entire river course before any final decision."

sentences.zh: 」 十二年，上親政，命葺治圓明園，奉皇太后駐蹕。

translations.literal: " In the twelfth year the emperor took personal rule and ordered repair of the Old Summer Palace for the empress dowager's residence.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year (1886) the emperor assumed personal rule and ordered repairs to the Old Summer Palace for the empress dowager's residence.

sentences.zh: 御史沈淮疏請暫緩修理，上特諭宣示孝養兩宮之意，專修安佑宮供奉列聖御容，暨皇太后駐蹕之所，治事之地，量從節儉，不事華靡，此外均不必興修。

translations.literal: Censor Shen Huai memorialized requesting temporary deferral of repairs; the emperor specially instructed, proclaiming the intent of filial nurture of the two palaces, to repair only the Palace of Imperial Peace to enshrine the portraits of successive sages, together with the places where the empress dowager resides and conducts affairs, keeping to economy in measure, not pursuing splendor—beyond this nothing need be built.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Shen Huai asked to defer repairs. The emperor proclaimed his filial duty to both palaces: only the Palace of Imperial Peace would be restored for ancestral portraits and the empress dowager's residence and offices, with strict economy and no extravagance elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 百川繼疏申諫，上召入詰責，百川侃侃正言無所撓，上為動容，一時敢諫之名動朝野。

translations.literal: Baichuan followed with a memorial remonstrating again; the emperor summoned him in and rebuked him; Baichuan spoke frankly and correctly without yielding; the emperor was moved, and for a time the name of bold remonstrance shook court and realm.
translations.idiomatic: Baichuan remonstrated again. Summoned and rebuked by the emperor, he spoke frankly without yielding. The emperor was moved, and his reputation for bold remonstrance spread through the court.

sentences.zh: 尋以憂歸，服除補官，遷給事中。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he returned home on mourning leave; when mourning ended he resumed office and was transferred to supervising secretary.
translations.idiomatic: He soon went home for mourning; after the mourning period he returned to office and was promoted to supervising secretary.

sentences.zh: 光緒五年，出為湖南衡永郴桂道，遷四川按察使，擢順天府尹，遷倉場侍郎。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Guangxu he went out to be intendant of the Heng-Yong-Chen-Gui circuit in Hunan, was transferred to be Sichuan provincial judge, was promoted to be metropolitan prefect of Shuntian, and was transferred to be vice president of the Granary and Storage Board.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Guangxu (1879) he became Hunan's Heng-Yong-Chen-Gui intendant, then Sichuan provincial judge, then metropolitan prefect of Shuntian, then vice president of the Granary and Storage Board.

sentences.zh: 九年，山東河決，被災者數十州縣，命百川往會巡撫陳士傑治工賑。

translations.literal: In the ninth year the Shandong river breached; several tens of prefectures and counties suffered disaster; Baichuan was ordered to go and join Governor Chen Shijie in managing works and relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year (1883) a Shandong river breach flooded dozens of counties. Baichuan was sent to join Governor Chen Shijie in relief and repair work.

sentences.zh: 百川輕騎週曆河南北岸、上下游，先散急賑。

translations.literal: Baichuan on light horse toured the north and south banks of Henan and the upper and lower reaches, first distributing urgent relief.
translations.idiomatic: Baichuan rode through Henan's north and south banks and the river's upper and lower reaches, distributing emergency relief first.

sentences.zh: 會奏請築兩岸遙堤，复於其內築縷堤，使黃水不致氾濫；

translations.literal: Jointly they memorialized requesting construction of distant dikes on both banks, and again building thread dikes within them, so that Yellow River water would not overflow;
translations.idiomatic: They jointly proposed outer dikes on both banks and inner thread dikes within them to contain the Yellow River;

sentences.zh: 又奏請濬小清河，分黃水入海：如議行。

translations.literal: they also memorialized requesting dredging of the Xiaoqing River to divide Yellow River water into the sea: as proposed, it was carried out.
translations.idiomatic: and dredging the Xiaoqing River to divert Yellow River water to the sea. The court approved.

sentences.zh: 還京，以倉廒被火，罷歸。

translations.literal: Returning to the capital, because the granaries caught fire he was dismissed and sent home.
translations.idiomatic: Back in the capital, he was dismissed after the granaries burned.

sentences.zh: 居數年，卒。

translations.literal: After residing several years, he died.
translations.idiomatic: He lived in retirement several years and died.

sentences.zh: （附） 沈淮 淮，字東川，浙江鄞縣人。

translations.literal: (Supplement) Shen Huai. Huai, whose style name was Dongchuan, was a native of Yin county in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: (Supplement) Shen Huai. Shen Huai, style name Dongchuan, came from Yin county in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 道光二十九年舉人，授內閣中書，充軍機章京。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year of Daoguang he passed the provincial examination and was appointed a secretary in the Grand Secretariat, serving also as a clerk on the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: He earned his juren degree in the twenty-ninth year of Daoguang (1849), entered the Grand Secretariat as a secretary, and served on the Grand Council staff.

sentences.zh: 咸豐十年，文宗狩熱河，淮不及從，慟哭欲投井，家人守之不得死。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Xianfeng the Wenzong Emperor went on hunt to Rehe; Huai could not follow in time, wept bitterly and wished to throw himself into a well, but his family guarded him and he could not die.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Xianfeng (1860), when the Xianfeng Emperor fled to Rehe, Huai could not accompany him and wept so bitterly he tried to throw himself into a well; his family stopped him.

sentences.zh: 遷刑部主事，進員外郎，授陝西道監察御史。

translations.literal: He was transferred to be a director in the Ministry of Justice, advanced to assistant department director, and appointed censor on the Shaanxi circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through the Ministry of Justice to assistant department director and was appointed Shaanxi circuit censor.

sentences.zh: 疏劾戶部主事楊鴻典攬權納賄，下刑部逮治，僅以小過議鐫級，及閻敬銘為尚書，始奏劾譴黜。

translations.literal: He memorialized impeaching Yang Hongdian, a director in the Ministry of Revenue, for monopolizing power and taking bribes; the case was sent to the Ministry of Justice for arrest and trial, but only a minor fault was debated for demotion by inscription; when Yan Jingming became minister, he at last memorialized impeachment and dismissal.
translations.idiomatic: He impeached Revenue director Yang Hongdian for grasping power and taking bribes. The case went to the Ministry of Justice, but Yang was only lightly demoted until Yan Jingming became minister and secured his dismissal.

sentences.zh: 園工興，淮疏首上，當時與百川齊名。

translations.literal: When work on the gardens began, Huai's memorial was the first submitted; at the time he was famed equally with Baichuan.
translations.idiomatic: When palace repairs began, Huai filed the first remonstrance and was famed alongside Baichuan.

sentences.zh: 光緒元年，充順天鄉試監試，力疾從事，出闈，旋卒。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangxu he served as supervisor of the Shuntian provincial examination, working despite illness; upon leaving the examination compound he soon died.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Guangxu (1875) he supervised the Shuntian provincial examination despite illness and died soon after leaving the examination compound.

sentences.zh: 家固中人產，官京師，斥賣殆盡，人尤服其清節。

translations.literal: His family was originally of middling means; while serving in the capital he sold off nearly everything, and people especially admired his integrity.
translations.idiomatic: His family had been comfortably off, but he sold nearly everything he owned during his years in the capital. People admired his integrity all the more.

sentences.zh: =【論】論曰：用兵之際，事機千變，京朝官以傳聞有所論列，往往不能切中。

translations.literal: =【Commentary】= The commentary says: In times of military employment, opportunities shift by the thousand; capital officials who discuss matters based on hearsay often cannot strike the mark.
translations.idiomatic: Commentary: In wartime opportunities shift constantly; capital officials who argue from rumor often miss the mark.

sentences.zh: 宗稷辰歸重得人，尹耕雲論諸將帥罪，王拯請調和疆吏，一意辦賊，為能見其大。

translations.literal: Zong Jichen valued obtaining men; Yin Gengyun discussed the guilt of various generals; Wang Zheng requested harmonizing frontier officials and devoting single intent to handling bandits—they were able to see the larger picture.
translations.idiomatic: Zong Jichen stressed finding the right men; Yin Gengyun judged generals' failures; Wang Zheng urged frontier officials to cooperate and focus on defeating rebels—they saw the larger picture.

sentences.zh: 拯所言尤詳盡，蓋直樞廷，見軍報，較得諸傳聞者異矣。

translations.literal: What Zheng stated was especially thorough and complete, for he was directly in the Grand Council and saw military reports—quite different from those who rely on hearsay.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng was the most thorough, for he sat on the Grand Council and read military reports rather than rumor.

sentences.zh: 穆緝香阿請慎選宦寺，遊百川等阻修圓明園，謇謇負直諫名，良不虛也。

translations.literal: Mu Jixianga requested careful selection of eunuchs; You Baichuan and others blocked repair of the Old Summer Palace—steadfast in bearing the name of blunt remonstrance, truly not in vain.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Jixianga urged careful choice of eunuchs; You Baichuan and others blocked Old Summer Palace repairs. Their reputations for blunt remonstrance were well earned.
